Explore the Virtual Laboratory How the Virtual Laboratory supports real customers The Virtual Lab service and Imagyst were instrumental in making sure we were not only able to get quality results to come up with a clear path forward, but also get rapid results that were not contingent upon weather conditions outside or wait times with local specialists. All we needed was right there." Dr. Lance Kidder Veterinarian at Sierra Veterinary Hospital, USA We wouldn’t have been able to know what to quite do with her unless I’d had that support from the Zoetis Virtual Laboratory [...]. We probably would have sat with her for a lot longer than I did. It’s been really great to see how this team can help make a difference to our patients." Dr. Chelsie Bailey Veterinarian at Kingfisher Vets, UK The consultation service has provided value for both us as clinicians, as well as clients. We’re able to get a very fast turn around, a second opinion, something that gives us a little bit of comfort."
